trade_calc_mode_name is resolved from the active MetaTrader5 package constants at capture time; the captured constant-value map is retained so the numeric code/name pair can be checked without guessing enum IDs.
Only documented linear contract-size profit modes are allowlisted; futures/tick-price, bond, collateral, unknown, and malformed modes are blocked from strict validation.
The calculation-mode check validates formula compatibility, not the broker's overall correctness or the authenticity of historical OHLC provenance.

execution_spec_audit.provenance_caveat: Matching instrument specifications and server labels do not independently authenticate that the OHLC history came from the named broker/feed.

methodology.execution_model: Same event-driven engine and costs in every scenario; only max_holding_bars changes.
methodology.time_stop: Stop/target/gap logic is evaluated first. If no stop/target exit occurs and the configured bar cap is reached, exit at the current completed bar close with adverse slippage and quote-side spread treatment.
methodology.bar_count_semantics: The entry bar counts as held bar 1. Nominal hours convert to bars by timeframe; actual elapsed wall-clock time can be longer due to market closures, holidays, and missing bars.
methodology.concurrency: Each scenario independently reruns the same candidate list; time stops can free concurrency slots for later candidates.
methodology.limitation: The bundled history was already examined in earlier research phases. This is lifecycle sensitivity analysis, not independent out-of-sample validation or evidence of profitability.
